topic: How to Remove Candle Wax From Fabric
notes: Keep the method limited to washable fabrics and care-label-compatible heat. The American Cleaning Institute supports scraping surface wax and transferring remaining wax with controlled warmth, but do not assume every fabric tolerates ironing or heat. If the care label prohibits ironing or the fabric is heat-sensitive, use a lower-risk label-compatible route or professional cleaning guidance.
